This plot is very small, only a quarter of a *timad*, so I cannot afford a whole bag of DAP just for it — one bag is too much and costs too much cash for me. I will put the manure from our few animals on the sorghum because it costs nothing, and I will use my own seed kept from last harvest like my mother taught me. My husband helps with the ox-plough but I do most of the weeding and bird-scaring myself, and we have no money to hire anyone.
